ai.title: India to host BRICS Chief Justices' Forum; CJI to hold bilateral meetings with judicial leaders
ai.description: New Delhi will host the BRICS Chief Justices' Forum from September 4 to 6. Chief Justice Surya Kant will meet senior judicial leaders from various nations. The forum will discuss justice delivery, international dispute resolution, and technology. Discussions will focus on mediation, arbitral awards, and artificial intelligence. Judicial leaders from BRICS and partner countries will share their perspectives.
ai.title_cn: 印度将主办金砖国家首席大法官论坛; CJI将与司法领导人举行双边会议
ai.description_cn: 新德里将于9月4日至6日主办金砖国家首席法官论坛。首席大法官苏里亚·康德将会见来自各国的高级司法领导人。该论坛将讨论正义交付、国际争端解决和技术。讨论将重点关注调解、仲裁裁决和人工智能。来自金砖国家和伙伴国家的司法领导人将分享他们的观点。

ai.title: US stocks open higher while oil prices continue to climb
ai.description: U.S. stocks are opening higher while oil prices continue to climb amid ongoing tension in the Middle East. Fighting between the U.S. and Iran has increased this week after the U.S. hit Iranian rocket launchers on an island in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday. The S&P 500 rose 0.5% in early trading Thursday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 368 points, or 0.7%, and the Nasdaq composite rose 0.6%. Nvidia rose 1% after the giant chip company said it would buy the artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face for $13 billion. Treasury yields moved lower in the bond market.
ai.title_cn: 美股开盘走高，油价继续攀升
ai.description_cn: 由于中东持续紧张局势，美国股市开盘走高，油价继续攀升。美国周日在霍尔木兹海峡的一个岛屿上击中了伊朗火箭发射器后，本周美国和伊朗之间的战斗有所加剧。周四早盘，标准普尔500指数上涨0.5%。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨368点，涨幅0.7%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨0.6%。英伟达股价上涨1%，此前该芯片巨头表示将以130亿美元收购人工智能平台Hugging Face。债券市场国债收益率走低。
